prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down RPG harbour town: old rounded cobblestones, grey-brown and slightly bluish stones of varied sizes (each stone about 6-12 art pixels across) set in dark mortar, a few mossy gaps, worn smooth tops. The square is 128 x 128 art pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square, seamless tileable pixel-art ground texture for a top-down RPG harbour town. Design on an exact conceptual 128 × 128 ART-PIXEL grid: all pixels crisp, uniformly sized squares, intended nearest-neighbor scale about 8×8 display pixels per art pixel. Old rounded cobblestones in grey-brown and muted slightly bluish grey, varied stones approximately 6–12 ART pixels across, closely fitted with irregular dark mortar; sparse small mossy gaps. Smooth worn upper surfaces, subtly hand-placed clusters of 3–10 pixels with clear silhouettes. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG aesthetic, carefully organized hue-shifted ramps: slightly saturated purple-red shadows, warm yellow highlights, 4–6 discrete shades per material. Earthy rich colours, calm neutral even overcast illumination from upper left. Orthographic directly overhead map surface without perspective. Strict seamless periodic tiling: stones and mortar patterns crossing left border continue precisely at right border, and those crossing top continue precisely at bottom. Fill whole canvas evenly with just cobblestone pavement, no frame, objects, text, focal feature, vignette, cast shadows, glow, lamps or night lighting. Absolutely no antialiasing, blur, soft brushing, photographic texture, random noise, or checkerboard dithering.
